items.subject: Gear Check In
items.summary: Sageview football gear check-in is this week: Juniors today 2:30 to 3:30, underclassmen Thursday and Friday.
items.action: Turn in football gear at gear check-in
items.body:
Gear check in this week at Football storage, north end of the field.

Monday Nov. 9: Seniors 2:30-3:30
Tuesday Nov. 10: Juniors 2:30-3:30
Thursday Nov. 12: Freshman and Sophomores 2:30-3:30
Friday Nov. 13: Freshman 2:30-3:30

Make sure:
- all uniforms, including practice jersey, are washed
- take the "Lobos" sticker off the helmet
- all gear is in your bag
- put your name on paper in the name tag slot on the bag
- don't forget Guardian caps
- fine for missing gear totals about $1,500

Don Hogue, Sageview High School Athletics
